takeaway: The aorta passes through the diaphragm at the aortic opening, T12, with the azygos and hemiazygos veins and the thoracic duct.

lines.text: At what level does the aorta pass through the diaphragm?
It passes through the aortic opening.
The aortic opening is at the T12 level.
lines.say: The aortic opening is at the T twelve level.

lines.text: The azygos and hemiazygos veins and the thoracic duct pass with it.
The inferior vena cava passes at T8, with the right phrenic nerve.
lines.say: The inferior vena cava passes at T eight, with the right phrenic nerve.

lines.text: Compare the vena cava opening at T8, and the oesophageal opening at T10.

lines.text: So the aorta passes at T12.
lines.say: So the aorta passes at T twelve.
